turn1.explanation: The unit responds about equally strongly to two different categories: dogs (and similar quadrupeds) and road vehicles such as cars, vans and trucks. Both mostly appear as a whole object seen side-on.
turn1.evidence: The top two images, both at 10, are a car and a dog, and the rest of the top 20 split between dogs (plus one weasel) and cars, police vehicles and a truck at similar activations (7-9). Nearly all are full-body side or three-quarter profiles, so a shared geometric cue ('elongated body on legs or wheels') could link them.
